description: Searchable command palette overlay (Cmd+K style) with filterable actions, descriptions, and keyboard shortcut hints. Supports two-way binding on open state; the backdrop dismisses on a click whose press started on it (a drag-select from the input that ends over the backdrop keeps it open). GroupByCategory adds a heading per category and a divider (CSS border) between groups; SplitShortcuts renders one kbd per key. Both default off, which keeps the flat list and the single shortcut kbd.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Whether the command palette is visible.

parameters.name: IsOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when IsOpen should change (two-way binding).

parameters.name: GroupByCategory
parameters.description: Groups actions by Category: a heading per category and a divider (CSS border) between groups. A null/empty category renders its options without a group wrapper (a role=group must be named). Defaults to false.

parameters.name: SplitShortcuts
parameters.description: Renders each '+'-separated part of a shortcut as its own kbd. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.
